newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India awards Cochin naphtha to Vitol at -$39/T.
newsitem.headline: India awards Cochin naphtha to Vitol at -$39/T.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded Dutch trader Vitol its sell tender for high aromatic naphtha (HAN) from Cochin on the west coast at $39 per tonne below Japanese spot quotes, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The 25,000-tonne cargo, lifting May 25-29, was awarded on a free-on-board (fob) basis in a tender that closed May 16 and was valid for a day.
The award was slightly firmer than IOC's last Cochin HAN award for a 30,000-tonne cargo lifting May 6-7, which was awarded at $40 below Japanese spot quotes, fob.
